description: Request body for creating a new vector store

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat type to use for AI responses

documents.description: Vector store documents configuration. One entry per uploaded file.

source.description: Source of the document (e.g. the bucket file key)

embeddingModels.description: Vector store embedding models configuration. Either provide existingModelId to reference a pre-seeded model, or provide modelName, modelProvider, dimension and releaseYear to define a new one.

oneOf.description: Use an existing embedding model by its ID

existingModelId.description: Unique identifier for an existing embedding model to use. Mutually exclusive with modelName, modelProvider, dimension and releaseYear.

modelName.description: Name of the embedding model to use

modelProvider.description: Provider of the embedding model (e.g., openai)

releaseYear.description: Release year of the embedding model

taskType.description: Task type of the embedding model

chunkSize.description: Size of text chunks to split documents into for embedding

chunkOverlap.description: Number of overlapping tokens between text chunks

chatAIOptions.description: Chat AI for vector store configuration

chatTypeId.description: Unique identifier for the chat type to use for AI responses

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for AI responses

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for AI responses (0 = deterministic, 2 = very random)

topP.description: Nucleus sampling threshold for AI responses (0-1)

frequencyPenalty.description: Penalty for repeating words/phrases in AI responses (-2 to 2)

presencePenalty.description: Penalty for repeating information from prompt in AI responses (-2 to 2)

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for AI response generation in case of failures
